link.title: Managing 3D Models
link.description: Load and manage the 3D models behind a configurator in the Composer. Everything a shopper sees starts here: which files are loaded, how they are positioned and scaled relative to each other, and which parts of them your options are allowed to change. These pages cover adding models to a scene, the properties you can set on each one, and the 3D file formats the Composer supports along with their trade-offs. Read the asset preparation pages alongside these if your models are coming out of a CAD tool or a 3D scanner.
